subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw change shipped automatic source-reply defaults toward message-tool-only or final-only delivery for direct and channel sessions, or keep automatic delivery as the default and add opt-in safeguards?
rationale: The remaining fix is not a narrow code-only bugfix because current behavior intentionally supports automatic visible replies, and changing that default affects existing user setups and channel UX/security tradeoffs.

options.title: Default safer delivery
options.body: Make affected external channel/source turns message-tool-only or final-only by default, with migration/docs/proof for users that relied on automatic bare-text replies.

options.title: Opt-in strict mode
options.body: Keep automatic delivery as the shipped default and land a documented opt-in strict, final-tag, or message-tool-only path for high-risk customer-facing channels.

options.title: Defer default change
options.body: Leave automatic delivery behavior unchanged for now and close or narrow candidate PRs until maintainers sponsor the broader policy change.

recommendation.title: Default safer delivery
recommendation.body: Make affected external channel/source turns message-tool-only or final-only by default, with migration/docs/proof for users that relied on automatic bare-text replies.
